before-clock-tower.npc: Hello adventurer. My name is Brother Kojo. Do you happen to know the time?
Exactly! This clock tower has recently broken down, and without it nobody can tell the correct time. I must fix it before the town people become too angry!
I don't suppose you could assist me in the repairs? I'll pay you for your help.

steps.player: OK old monk, what can I do?

steps.npc: Oh, thank you kind [sir/madam]! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.
I know one goes on each floor... but I can't exactly remember which goes where specifically. Oh well, I'm sure you can figure it out fairly easily.
Thank you again! And remember to be careful, the cellar is full of strange beasts!
OK then. Come back and let me know if you change your mind.

after-clock-tower.npc: Oh hello there traveller. You've done a grand job with the clock. It's just like new.

with-a-chart-and-sextant-in-the-inventor.npc: Hello, traveller, how can I help?

with-a-chart-and-sextant-in-the-inventor.player: I'm trying to learn how to be a navigator.

with-a-chart-and-sextant-in-the-inventor.npc: I don't know if I can help you there.

with-a-chart-and-sextant-in-the-inventor.player: The professor from the Observatory says that I need a watch.

with-a-chart-and-sextant-in-the-inventor.npc: Ah, that I can help you with. I've been tinkering with this new idea of a watch and made a few. The problem is the villagers don't see the point as they have the Clock Tower!
You can have this one! It's the display model.

with-a-chart-and-sextant-in-the-inventor.text: Brother Kojo has given you a watch.

treasure-trails-hard.npc: I need you to answer this for me.

treasure-trails-hard.text: Brother Kojo has given you a challenge scroll!

treasure-trails-hard-speaking-to-him-aga.text: If the player did not answer the challenge scroll already:

steps.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!

steps.text: Brother Kojo has given you another clue scroll!
